title: Heavenly Messages
body:
There is no fanaticism in real religions. None in Judaism, nor in Christianity, nor in Islam. All religions which
believe in all prophets and in all the revelations coming to them through the Creator, are the same. But the
level of understanding of people changes and grows through the ages. Which is why the messages from the
Creator improve and change, according to the times.
It is difficult to practise a message today which was sent 4000 years ago. The understanding of people 2000
years ago was also different than today. There are questions today which cannot be answered with full
contentment by Christianity. Just like there are dogmas within Christianity which people today cannot
understand. As a result many new churches are forming; Methodists, Baptists... every new church has a new
title.
This is necessary, because even the understanding which people had of the church at the beginning of this
century is not suitable for people now. Like a stone will not dissolve in hot tea, but a lump of sugar will, the
dogmas of the church are like stones, the people will not be able to digest them. So they try to grind them,
and still it doesn't work. It is so difficult. In Islam you cannot find any dogma or slogan which is contrary to
science or positive knowledge. If anyone wants to challenge that, you can try! According to their
understanding, people can reach a discipline through their beliefs. When the strength of a belief decreases,

the discipline in that religion will also decrease. That is why there is no discipline in Christianity any more. It
is finished! In Judaism there are only three diamonds left in a square. They cannot get out, nor can they
accept anyone else to get in. They are so fanatical, the Jewish people are the most fanatical living on earth at
the moment. They are closed within themselves.
If there is no discipline, there is no current, no spiritual power coming through. In the Last Message, the
Quran, discipline is the strong basis. Without discipline problems will increase from day to day. The society
of the west is like a very ill body. There is no civilisation. People are growing up in wildness. The civilisation is
corrupt. The invention of so many technical appliances doesn't change the fact that the civilisation has come
to the point of zero. There is no humanity left. I am happy to say that there are still a few families in Great
Britain which try to keep their old customs, I wish all people would do that. But it is a bit like the situation in
Kew Gardens where there is a protected area, a greenhouse, where special plants can grow. Generally, there
are no good manners left. If people would use discipline and learn respect this would not happen. The reason
why western countries are against Islam is that they want people to live freely, without discipline, which is
impossible. If you go to school you also have to follow discipline. You couldn't just send a tramp to the Oxford
University. This free will which is represented in the west, is impossible.
01.01.1996
